message.content:
In Blackjack, an Ace can be counted as **either 1 or 11**, depending on which value gives your hand the best advantage without causing a bust.  

- If counting the Ace as 11 keeps your total at 21 or below, you’ll usually treat it as 11.  
- If adding 11 would push your total over 21, you’ll treat the Ace as 1 instead.  

This flexibility allows you to “soft” hands (e.g., Ace‑6 = 17) that can still improve if you draw another card.
